claims.statement: SE-GNN is a supervised next-vertex policy, not a one-shot edge heatmap model.
PUCT uses sibling-normalized best-value backups and neural beam-completion leaf evaluation, not a learned critic.
Per-instance reported time reaches 292 minutes for 1000 vertices; host has eight 2080 Ti GPUs and 32 concurrent instances.
TSP-only supervised size-specific models construct tours with search; specialist constructive classification.
